theme.notes: Windy is a full-viewport meteorological map: deep navy-indigo map canvas (#162c4f shadow tones, #041c49 indigo, near-black navy #000722 in shaded panels) under translucent dark-gray chrome panels (#4d4d4e mode, #4f5152 bottom bar, #4c4d4d cluster). UI accents are warm: amber/gold #d49500 (Go Premium pill 65.1%, time badge 75.4%, active model ECMWF fill #c6931c, selected dates), alert/brand red #9d0300 (play triangle, hamburger) and #a71c20 (brand circle). The map itself is a data-driven cool field: blues #3a66a1/#536bae, cyans #4a94a2, greens #47a447/#53a554, warm yellows/olives toward red. Little to no decorative glow — depth comes from translucency and soft black drop shadows.

frame.notes: No outer application frame — the map fills the viewport and free-floating translucent panels anchor to its edges. Depth is soft black drop shadow, not borders or glow.

cards.notes: Cards/widgets are closed rounded surfaces: grouped widgets and forecast panels 8–12px radius (10px used), compact labels/pills 18–22px, icon buttons fully circular (measured red button radius ≈21px). Hairline low-contrast chrome edge (#6a6a6c vision-estimated thin border; panels are otherwise borderless translucent gray) + soft black drop shadow instead of any glow.

dividers.notes: Timeline day cells separated by faint 1px vertical rules (BMP rule columns detected at ~+18 luminance over the #4d4d4d strip); control cluster uses separator bars between grouped buttons.

inputs.notes: Location search field is a pill (measured box 12,10–393,44, radius ≈20px) and is WHITE with dark text on Windy — a light-field divergence; the terminal composer keeps the dark chrome well but adopts the pill radius.

activeIndicators.notes: Active state is a FILL, not a bar: selected layer (Wind) gets a brighter chrome fill, active model (ECMWF 9km) gets the amber #d49500 fill with dark text, selected timeline date gets amber text, current time gets the amber badge. No left accent bars anywhere.

regions.name: mapCanvas
regions.notes: Full-viewport dynamic weather map — cool blue/cyan/green data field with pale cyan-white wind particle streamlines; in the terminal adaptation the center workspace follows the dark chrome surfaces instead of a live map.

regions.name: topBar
regions.notes: Left: white search pill + forecast panel + notification card. Center: red brand circle #a71c20 + Windy.com wordmark. Right: amber Go Premium pill, Login pill, Menu label, red circular hamburger #9d0300.

regions.name: leftBar
regions.notes: Current-conditions/forecast panel (large thin-white 28°, daily columns, amber intensity strip) above a notification article card.

regions.name: rightBar
regions.notes: Layer rail (Weather radar/Satellite/Wind/Rain thunder/Temperature/…, Wind selected) over the map; below it the control cluster (+/3D/info/fullscreen + toolbar), model selector (ECMWF 9km active amber, GFS 22km, ICON 13km), and the kt color-scale legend.

regions.name: bottomBar
regions.notes: Full-width dark timeline strip: white circular play button with red triangle, amber 8:00 time badge, scrubber, day cells with faint vertical rules, amber selected dates.

regions.name: rightRailWidgets
regions.notes: Segmented buttons, legend bar, toggles — all translucent chrome with pill/10px radii.

featured.name: WIND MAP
featured.notes: Windy's signature is the animated wind field itself — it replaces the WORLD VIEW globe: deep-navy canvas with drifting pale-cyan wind particles along a flow field, kt legend bar, and a mini forecast timeline (white play button with red triangle, amber time badge, day ticks).
